title: Check legacy lifecycle readiness on iOS 27.2
scope: C03 only; first check unmodified pre-scene baseline host readiness on the unexercised 27.2 runtime
source_verification: All369 source files from the exact Git revision match the recorded archive manifest; all4 current fixture files and the retained binary match original recorded hashes. The old extracted source directory is incomplete and is not reused.
preflight_sequence: Discover a usable iPhone simulator on iOS27.2 and use a fresh run ID/output directory.
Verify exact Git archive and current fixture hashes against original records, executable hash/UUID and absent scene manifest.
Copy the frozen control app unchanged, prove clean app/data absence, install and verify installed executable hash.
Run automatic Home/Detail/freshHome once and require exact recorded run identity, no scene manifest and existing ownership oracle.
If the known UIKit startup trap recurs before a terminal result, record fresh PID/time/UUID-matched crash evidence and stop before candidate rebuild or further modes.
Always terminate only the fixture if present, prove cleanup and restore a simulator booted by this run to its prior shutdown state.
conditional_full_matrix: Only if baseline readiness passes: freeze an implementation for current-candidate vs original-baseline automatic/manual navigation and actual OS background/foreground pairs on27.2. Retain accepted26.5 proof; do not rerun unrelated gates.
closure_rule: C03 closes only after the complete unchanged exact-ownership/occurrence/lifecycle oracle passes for both arms. A baseline-only PASS is readiness, and a repeated baseline platform trap is INCONCLUSIVE rather than SDK regression or compatibility acceptance.
prohibited_shortcuts: No scene manifest or synthetic lifecycle notifications to bypass the legacy requirement.
No binary SDK-version patching, UIKit assertion suppression, debugger launch, threshold changes or new public API.
No reuse of old run IDs or alteration of original EXP-160 evidence.
